items.raw_excerpt: This French expression is all about making a big impression.
items.summary_en: This French expression means to make a big impression. People say someone arrived en grande pompe when they showed up in a very showy way. It is a fun phrase to use when someone enters a room with lots of attention.
items.summary_ko: 이 프랑스 표현은 화려하게 등장하거나 크게 인상을 남긴다는 뜻이다. 누군가 매우 화려한 모습으로 나타났을 때 앙 그랑퐁이라고 말한다. 누군가가 화려하게 무대에 오르는 모습을 표현할 때 쓰는 재미있는 구이다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: En grande pompe
items.title_ko: 프랑스 표현 배우기: 앙 그랑퐁
items.title_original: French Expression of the Day: En grande pompe

items.raw_excerpt: Take advantage of this chance to learn a very useful Italian word.
items.summary_en: The Local Italy shares one useful Italian word each day. Today's word is approfittare, which means to take advantage of something, such as a good chance. It is a short, practical word for everyday life in Italy.

items.raw_excerpt: Applicants with previous education from three South Asian countries will face an additional in-person step when applying to certain programmes at Johannes Kepler University Linz from the summer semester of 2027.
items.summary_en: JKU Linz university in Austria will ask some applicants to come in person. This rule applies to people who studied in India, Pakistan, or Bangladesh. It starts with the summer semester of 2027.

items.raw_excerpt: Today's word should help you understand Swedish politics a little better.
items.summary_en: Today's word helps you understand Swedish politics a little better. Sonderingsperson means a person who looks into an issue or question carefully before making a decision. In politics, it often describes a minister who studies a problem first.

items.raw_excerpt: História insular: saiba tudo sobre a fundação deste tradicional bairro nordestino que nasceu faixa de terra e virou ilha por aterros.
items.summary_en: The oldest neighborhood of Recife, a capital city in northeast Brazil, started as a very thin strip of land. People added soil and rubble to the water for many centuries, and this slow work joined the land to the shore. The area turned into an island, and its old name and local ways still live on today.

items.raw_excerpt: A sus 23 años, Mario Pérez tomó una decisión que hoy puede parecer poco habitual entre los jóvenes de su generación. El valenciano dejó atrás su tierra natal...
items.summary_en: At 23, Mario Perez left his hometown of Valencia to open a bar in a village with fewer than 100 people. He says his idea of success is simple: having no reason to leave. The small bar has become popular with locals and visitors.
